title: Progression by biome
dek: What each ring of the world adds: new raw materials, what they let you craft, and what to build before you move on.
audience: A player planning where to go next.

sections.heading: How the world is laid out

blocks.template: The world is a set of rings around your starting point. Each ring is one biome and is about {ring_width} wide, and the pattern repeats after {ring_count} rings.
Zombies get stronger the farther you are from the start: every {zombie_level_step} adds a level, and each level adds health and damage.
Loot quality can also rise with distance: the best possible quality goes up one tier every {quality_step}.

Generated from game version {game_version} (Steam build {build_id}). Distances are in metres, the unit the game itself uses when it shows speeds in m/s. Chances per dig hit come from the game's weighted pick. A container's biome is inferred from the name of the asset bundle it ships in.
